name: Shenzhen Phoenix Telecom Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Phoenix Telecom Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of network equipment and other communication equipment components. It offers switches, routers, wireless, and automotive electronics products. The company also provides manufacturing services. It serves operators, government, finance, education, energy, electricity, transportation, small and medium-sized enterprises, hospitals, and personal consumption markets. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
